summary: RETEST of iter-156 Super Admin panel — ALL PASS. Grep on AdminDashboard.jsx confirms code changes (isSuperAdmin line 18, super-admin-panel line 89, 3 super-admin-tile-* testids, 'Super Admin · Control room' overline line 127). Admin login (9970705391) via dev OTP → /admin renders [data-testid=super-admin-panel] with red gradient (bg-gradient-to-br from-primary via-primary to-red-800), 'Super Admin' heading with Sparkles icon, all 3 tiles (messes/reviews/branding) present, overline 'SUPER ADMIN · CONTROL ROOM' visible, and clicking super-admin-tile-messes navigates to /super-admin/messes showing 4 tenant rows (Auto Gen, Mumbai Khar, Amravati, Yavatmal). Non-admin regression: subscriber (9175560211, role=subscriber) attempting /admin is redirected to /dashboard by RequireAuth — panel NOT rendered. iter-155 was indeed a false-negative from stale bundle read.

issues: Mess list uses card layout, not an HTML <table>. Not a bug (looks great), just clarifying the acceptance criterion 'mess table renders' resolves to the mess list cards.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin panel is fully working. Auth uses session_token (not token) key from /api/auth/verify-otp response. Non-admin users hitting /admin are redirected to /dashboard by RequireAuth guard.
rca of the issue: iter-155 reported 0% pass because it read a stale JS bundle before frontend restart. After supervisor restart+cache-bust query param, the panel renders correctly on first load. No code change needed.
